$comment: The kit's ONE default remote layout (ADR-001 amendment 9): one root on the server; one directory per project directly under it; inside a project, one disjoint tree per environment; inside an environment, one directory per deployed service (its `unit`) and the stack's own configuration. A target overrides any template (`layout`). Value placeholders: {root} the target's absolute root, {project} the project slug, {environment} dev|prod, {service} the compose service, {container} its container, {folder} the module's secrets folder, {infraSlug} the infra stack's slug. `{@kind}` is another template of this file. Every rendered path must lie under `project` (the resolver refuses one that escapes). `pending` names the places declared ahead of the delivery that fills them.

pending.releases: a release per version and a `current` pointer replace the unit's versions/ folder once the delivery is proven against a docker host
pending.runtime: runtime config (modules.<id>.runtimeConfig) is declared and validated; its upload and read-only mount are proven against a docker host first
pending.stack: one compose file per environment, and the env files beside it, replace each unit's own once proven against a docker host
